answer: A per-identity bond escrowed on-ledger, plus trust starting at zero for each fresh address, is the core Sybil barrier. A wallet split into a thousand clones must post that stake a thousand times, and each clone earns nothing until it separately completes on-chain work, so attacker capital and compute grow linearly while income per seat stays flat. The farmer locks an ocean of collateral across the fleet but collects like one harbor boat in a crowd, pushing marginal accounts below cost. Honest agents post once and withdraw, so each new vine of identity pays its own toll.
